Let's be honest, we get lazy about training. Booking a court, finding people to play with and planning the week are exactly the chores we skip. So Serve hands them all to a team of AI agents, built on Meta's open Muse Glimmer model.

Just say what you want. Muse Glimmer reads the request. The agent opens the club map, checks every court and lines up both calendars. Then it picks the venue in the middle, seventeen minutes for me and twelve for Kenji. It writes the challenge in my voice and checks every time and price. Nothing is booked until I say yes. Then it holds the court and follows up until the game is on.
Every job is a task you can watch. Your agent hands each question to the right coach, and checks back when it needs you.

Behind it sits a staff of five coach agents, built from one phone video. Coach Lin flashes the zone that cost the most points, seven of the twenty-four winners you conceded. Coach Ren builds the week around a sore knee, with no jump drills. Ask any of them, and a verifier checks every number before you see it.
They even plan your training. The coaches debate your match, the head coach settles it by a fixed rule, health first, and they agree four goals and a seven-day plan.

Then the plan comes with you. Your twenty-four-hour coach lives in your pocket, in Facebook Messenger. It sends the week, nudges you an hour before training with a meal from your own kitchen, and checks in that evening to log the session and adjust tomorrow.

After the game, your agent cuts your highlight reel. Meta's Sapiens2 reads both players' pose, and SAM 2.1 cuts them out of every frame. So the smash replays in slow motion, at the broadcast angle, without a frame of footage. {+3} Muse Glimmer writes the caption, and every number in it is checked against the rallies. {+1.5} One tap, and it is on Instagram or Facebook.

And the coaches keep learning. A research agent reads sports science, and every night each coach proposes changes to its own playbook. A change is adopted only if it cites a study, passes the safety rules and does no worse on its tests, and anything about health waits for me.

Your club becomes a game, with quests, a boss, and a leaderboard that every challenge moves. Then your agent finds your best match: fair by rating, free when you are, and good for your weak zone. And it talks to their agent, agent to agent, until both agree a time and a court.
Serve. Play more, manage less. A twenty-four-hour coaching staff in your pocket, built on Muse Glimmer.
